jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who can spot a perfectly poured beer faster than a bad joke? 

Do you love a bustling hospitality environment, fun coworkers, and a bar that’s never boring? 

Then we’re sure to have your next challenge waiting for you.
 

Bier Central Brussels is looking for a full-time bartender to join the team.
 

What will you be doing?
 

- Pouring beer as if it were an art form. 

- Welcome guests with a smile. 

- Take orders and serve drinks. 

- Keep the bar clean and organized. 

- Help create the lively atmosphere that Bier Central is known for.

- Ideally, you already have some serious experience working behind a bar.

- You live in Brussels.

- You don’t rely on public transportation. We close between midnight and 1:00 a.m., so being able to get home on your own is important.

- Working on weekends is a given for you.

- You understand and speak French at a basic level.

- You speak and understand English. Other languages? Those are just bonus points.

jobs.occupation: COMPLIANCE DATA AND REPORTING OFFICER, Junior role M/W/X
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Compliance Data and Reporting Officer to support the Compliance function in strengthening the quality, reliability, and efficiency of its data, reporting, and information management processes. This is a junior role designed for a rigorous and analytical profile who is comfortable working with data, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and contributing to the continuous improvement of compliance processes in a fast-growing fintech environment. 

In this role, you will help ensure the timely preparation, coordination, and delivery of compliance reports, including periodic and ad hoc data regulatory reporting. You will maintain reporting calendars, monitor deadlines, support the collection and validation of relevant data, and contribute to the production of accurate and structured reporting outputs for internal stakeholders and, where applicable, regulators. 

The position will contribute to broader compliance management initiatives aimed at improving the use of tools and technology within the Compliance function, including reporting workflows, JIRA-based tracking, data visualisation, automation, and AI-supported information processing. Through these activities, you will play an important role in helping Compliance teams make better use of data, reduce manual effort, and enhance the reliability of management information. 

The position reports functionally and administratively to the Global Head of Regulatory Affairs. 
 
What you will do  

• Maintain reporting calendars and ensure timely delivery of all compliance reports 
• Work closely with product and data team for regulatory periodic and ad hoc reporting  
• Support enhancements to digital onboarding data capture and KYC process automation 
• Support data quality initiatives to ensure accuracy and completeness of compliance reporting 
• Identify opportunities for data process optimization and automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort 
• Provide data insights and analytical support to Compliance Officers and first-line teams 
• Identify practical obstacles to data quality and reporting processes 
• Escalate data-related issues and improvement needs to appropriate owners 
• Support in transmitting reports to regulators of some designated countries 
• Support any compliance management initiatives aiming at enhancing compliance data processing and visualiztion (e.g. JIRA) and information processing (AI) 

What do you bring? 
• You hold a master's degree or equivalent in business law, banking and financial law, financial economics, or a related field 
• You have 1+ year of experience in Fintech or Paytech environment 
• You are rigorous, well-organised, and comfortable working with data and producing structured reports 
• You have strong analytical skills and are able to synthesise complex information into actionable insights 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint and ease of learning other tool capabilities (JIRA, AI) 
• 
You are fluent in English, French is a plus 

 
 
What do we offer? 

• Diverse missions and projects in an innovative and growing Fintech company; 
• A meaningful role within the second line of defence, with real visibility and impact; 
• A professional, international team with a collaborative and flat hierarchy; 
• A dynamic and supportive work environment in Brussels.

Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• Angular experience is a big asset
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

For a key Belgian player in the energy transition, JOBS IN MIND is looking for a Site Engineer to join a major offshore high-voltage infrastructure project. You will contribute to the development of new energy infrastructure connecting Belgian offshore wind power to the electricity grid.
 

Your role
 

As Site Engineer, you will be part of the construction team and work across the sites in Vlissingen and Schiedam, combined with the office in Brussels. You report to the Construction Lead and act as a key link between engineering, construction, quality and the EPC contractor.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring safety and quality on site 

• Providing technical follow-up, mainly for electromechanical works 

• Acting as the main contact for technical questions from the engineering team 

• Supporting the Construction Manager and site team 

• Taking technical ownership of issues arising during outfitting and escalating major issues when required 

• Coordinating and participating in site inspections 

• Following up on quality issues and non-conformities 

• Reviewing technical documentation submitted by the contractor 

• Coordinating suppliers and external parties on site 

• Managing and structuring incoming inspection reports 

• Preparing weekly and monthly reports 

• Supporting technical analyses and improvement initiatives  

You will work in a multidisciplinary team with inspectors, outfitting engineers, design engineers, construction managers and other project specialists.
 

The project
 

The project involves the development of a new offshore energy hub to connect Belgian offshore wind farms to the electricity grid. The infrastructure includes:
 
 

• An artificial energy island with offshore transmission infrastructure 

• AC substations at 66 kV and 220 kV 

• 6 export cable systems of approximately 50 km each  

Construction of the substations is currently ongoing in Vlissingen and Schiedam. Outfitting activities are starting in summer 2026, making this a key position for the next phase of the project.

Profile:
 
 

• Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering 

• Offshore experience is a strong plus 

• Experience with topside outfitting is a plus 

• Experience across multiple technical disciplines is an advantage 

• Experience with QA/QC on a construction site is a plus 

• VCA VOL / SCC Supervisor certificate 

• Strong MS Office skills and good technical reporting abilities 

• Knowledge of Aconex is a plus 

• Strong safety and quality mindset 

• Structured and team-oriented way of working 

• Strong communication skills 

• Quick learner 

• Own standard PPE is required 

• Languages: Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.  

Practical information
 
 

• Employment: Full-time, 5 days per week / 8 hours per day 

• Locations: Vlissingen, Schiedam and Brussels 

• Preferred: Based in Belgium or the Netherlands  

For non-EU candidates, a valid work permit and residence permit allowing employment in Belgium are required.
 

Why this project?
 

This is an opportunity to join a technically challenging offshore energy project directly contributing to the energy transition. You will work with international engineering and construction teams and gain valuable experience within a high-impact infrastructure project.

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

YOUR PROFILE
